## [Viltrox NexusFocus F1 Brings AI Autofocus to Manual Cine Glass](https://camerajabber.com/photography-news/viltrox-nexusfocus-f1-brings-ai-autofocus-to-manual-cine-glass/)
*Camera Jabber* | 24/01/2026 | Score: 1.00
Tags: photography, camera, lens

> Viltrox has announced a groundbreaking new product for filmmakers and vintage lens enthusiasts: the NexusFocus F1, a high-precision autofocus adapter that transforms manual PL-mount cinema lenses into intelligent, autofocus-capable tools on Sony E-mount cameras. Launched via Kickstarter on January 15th, the NexusFocus F1 is the first adapter of its kind to offer full FIZ (focus, iris, zoom) motor control powered by AI subject recognition and Sony’s phase-detection autofocus (PDAF) system. This compact yet robust adapter allows creators to integrate legendary cine optics into modern autofocus workflows, opening new creative possibilities for solo shooters, run-and-gun filmmakers, and small crews. By pairing classic manual lenses with Sony’s advanced subject-tracking features, the NexusFocus F1 eliminates the need for external LiDAR systems, making AI autofocus more accessible and efficient in dynamic shooting environments.
